issue.title: Bug: Uninitialized attr used in SAI call when speed unsupported

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

**Overview**:

In the `setGearboxPortAttr()` function in `orchagent/portsorch.cpp`, there is a critical bug where the `sai_attribute_t attr` variable may be used uninitialized when setting the SAI_PORT_ATTR_SPEED attribute. If isSpeedSupported() returns false, the attr variable is never initialized, yet the code proceeds to make a SAI API call with this uninitialized data at line 3370, leading to undefined behavior.

**Code Snippets**:

We create an uninitialized attr here:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/blob/9b237a2e40c8698a167e6b8783afaf943191ff16/orchagent/portsorch.cpp#L3308

We only set the attr.id and attr.value.u32 if isSpeedSupported is True:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/blob/9b237a2e40c8698a167e6b8783afaf943191ff16/orchagent/portsorch.cpp#L3343-L3354
```
if (isSpeedSupported(port.m_alias, dest_port_id, speed))
{
    // Gearbox may not implement speed check, so
    // invalidate speed if it doesn't make sense.
    if (to_string(speed).size() < 5)
    {
        speed = 0;
    }

    attr.id = SAI_PORT_ATTR_SPEED;
    attr.value.u32 = speed;
}
```

Regardless of whether attr is uninitialized we end up making the SAI call:
`status = sai_port_api->set_port_attribute(dest_port_id, &attr);`
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/blob/9b237a2e40c8698a167e6b8783afaf943191ff16/orchagent/portsorch.cpp#L3370

### Steps to Reproduce

Attempt to set a speed which is not supported. Alternatively, set isSpeedSupported to return False, to hit the logical path where an uninitialized attr is passed to set_port_attribute SAI call.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual behavior:
Leads to the following error logs:
```
	 E               2026 Jan 17 <IPV6>.925694 ctn102 ERR swss#orchagent: :- setGearboxPortAttr: BOX: Failed to set Ethernet72 port attribute 31
	 E
	 E               2026 Jan 17 <IPV6>.925694 ctn102 ERR swss#orchagent: :- handleSaiFailure: Encountered failure in set operation, SAI API: SAI_API_PORT, status: SAI_STATUS_INVALID_ATTR_VALUE_0
	 E
	 E               2026 Jan 17 <IPV6>.932105 ctn102 ERR swss#orchagent: :- meta_generic_validation_set: unable to find attribute metadata SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_PORT:378307824
	 E
```

Expected Behavior:
The code should never pass uninitialized attributes to SAI calls.

### Relevant log output

```shell
E               2026 Jan 17 <IPV6>.925694 ctn102 ERR swss#orchagent: :- setGearboxPortAttr: BOX: Failed to set Ethernet72 port attribute 31
	 E
	 E               2026 Jan 17 <IPV6>.925694 ctn102 ERR swss#orchagent: :- handleSaiFailure: Encountered failure in set operation, SAI API: SAI_API_PORT, status: SAI_STATUS_INVALID_ATTR_VALUE_0
	 E
	 E               2026 Jan 17 <IPV6>.932105 ctn102 ERR swss#orchagent: :- meta_generic_validation_set: unable to find attribute metadata SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_PORT:378307824
	 E
```

resolution.title: Gracefully handle case when speed is not supported in setGearboxPortAttr
resolution.description:
Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/25311

**What I did**
Fixed a bug in setGearboxPortAttr() where an uninitialized sai_attribute_t attr variable could be passed to the SAI API when isSpeedSupported() returns false for SAI_PORT_ATTR_SPEED operations.

The fix adds an else block that logs the unsupported speed and returns false early, preventing the SAI call with uninitialized data

**Why I did it**
This causes the following error logs to be printed:
```
	 E               2026 Jan 17 <IPV6>.925578 ctn102 ERR gbsyncd#syncd: :- processQuadEvent: attr: SAI_PORT_ATTR_SPEED: 400000
	 E
	 E               2026 Jan 17 <IPV6>.925694 ctn102 ERR swss#orchagent: :- setGearboxPortAttr: BOX: Failed to set Ethernet72 port attribute 31
	 E
	 E               2026 Jan 17 <IPV6>.925694 ctn102 ERR swss#orchagent: :- handleSaiFailure: Encountered failure in set operation, SAI API: SAI_API_PORT, status: SAI_STATUS_INVALID_ATTR_VALUE_0
	 E
	 E               2026 Jan 17 <IPV6>.932105 ctn102 ERR swss#orchagent: :- meta_generic_validation_set: unable to find attribute metadata SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_PORT:378307824
```

**How I verified it**
Verified that the fix prevents the uninitialized variable from being used in a SAI call
